# Motionmaxxing

A motion direction skill that makes professional motion graphics films (launch videos, product promos, feature reveals, brand stings, kinetic type pieces, social ads and CTAs) in HyperFrames or plain HTML. It finds an idea only the brand could own (from its logo, core control, material, verb or voice), builds a world for it, animates with a seek-safe GSAP runtime using curves measured frame by frame from 53 professional recreations, and reviews its own render with scripted gates (look.py for render, empty frames and end card, lint.mjs for page chrome) instead of self-certifying. Given a website URL it captures the brand (colours, fonts, official logo, copy, screenshots). With an ElevenLabs key it can voice the script, generate sound effects and music and cut picture and sound together; with the Codex CLI it can generate image surface plates. Hard requirements are local tools only: Node.js 22 or newer, Python 3.9 or newer, ffmpeg and Google Chrome. The folder ships 90 files: the method, 14 reference files, the runtime with vendored Three.js and GSAP, and 12 scripts.
